title.en: Concrete yield sets the section order for Rural Diesel Concrete Pump
title.zh: 混凝土出料体积决定这篇农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的章节顺序

description.en: Concrete yield is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Rural Diesel Concrete Pump. The published table prints Diesel Engine Power 17 kW; Theoretical Output 5–8 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m; Vertical Delivery Height 10–30 m; Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm; Hopper Capacity 0.2 m³; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; Total Weight 800 kg.
description.zh: 混凝土出料体积只决定章节顺序。标题下面的格子仍是已经印出的格子。邢台河北品锦机械公布农村自建房柴油混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：柴油机功率17 kW；理论输送量5–8 m³/h；泵送压力15 MPa；水平输送距离30–50 m；垂直输送高度10–30 m；最大骨料粒径1–3 cm；料斗容积0.2 m³；外形尺寸2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm；整机重量800 kg。

heading.zh: 如何避免出料体积偏差

body.en: Under the source heading “HOW to Prevent Yield Discrepancies”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai and name Rural Diesel Concrete Pump. This page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Do not borrow a diameter from another model. The specification table does not include a price cell. Leave cylinder bore, piston stroke and service life blank when they are absent above. Image from the source page: https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/08pr.pdf
